title: Claude Code vs Aider: Which Terminal AI Coding Agent Wins in 2026?
summary: Claude Code is Anthropic's plan-first terminal agent. Aider is open-source and works with any model. Both edit code but leave infrastructure to you. Here's the honest comparison.
body_markdown: For large codebases, Aider's token-efficient diff format and selective repository mapping mean significantly lower API costs. Independent analysis found Aider uses 4.2x fewer tokens than Claude Code for comparable editing tasks. Claude Code at the Pro plan ($20/mo) has usage limits; heavy users typically need Max ($100–$200/mo).[Blink](https://blink.new/) 's $20/mo Pro plan includes the infrastructure that typically costs $70–120/mo separately (Postgres, auth, hosting) — if you're building a new product, Blink is often cheaper all-in than either terminal agent plus a separate infrastructure stack.
